title: Leave, Closure and Dormancy Figures by Employee Meal Account Plan
content:
An Employee Meal Account may be parked while the employee is on recorded leave, closed when they ask for it, and treated as dormant when the badge stops being used. Seven figures are printed against each meal plan for those three situations.

| Meal plan | Longest leave the account may be parked for | Notice needed to unpark on return | Notice the employee gives before closure | Unspent stored value returned within | Smallest unspent balance returned | Dormant after | Monthly dormancy charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | 3 months | 1 calendar day | 0 calendar days | 0 calendar days | $0.00 | 12 months | $0.00 |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | 6 months | 2 calendar days | 7 calendar days | 30 calendar days | $5.00 | 12 months | $2.00 |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | 6 months | 3 calendar days | 14 calendar days | 21 calendar days | $5.00 | 18 months | $0.00 |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | 12 months | 5 calendar days | 14 calendar days | 21 calendar days | $5.00 | 18 months | $0.00 |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | 12 months | 5 calendar days | 7 calendar days | 0 calendar days | $0.00 | 24 months | $0.00 |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | 12 months | 7 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 45 calendar days | $10.00 | 24 months | $0.00 |

## What each figure is

1. The leave ceiling is the longest recorded leave the account may be parked for, in whole months.
2. The unparking notice is the calendar days of notice needed to unpark an account on return from leave.
3. The closure notice is the calendar days of notice the employee gives before the account closes.
4. The balance return window is the calendar days after closure within which unspent stored value is returned, and the return floor is the smallest unspent balance the plan returns at closure.
5. The dormancy figure is the months without a till transaction after which the account counts as dormant, and the dormancy charge is the monthly charge on a dormant account.

## Reading across the plans

Leave ceilings run 3 months on the Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account, 6 months on the Prepaid Declining Balance Account and the Payroll Deduction Meal Account, and 12 months on the remaining three. Unparking notice runs 1, 2, 3, 5, 5 and 7 calendar days in plan order, and closure notice 0, 7, 14, 14, 7 and 30 calendar days. Two plans print a 0 calendar day return window and a $0.00 return floor, holding no stored value to return; the other four print windows of 30, 21, 21 and 45 calendar days against floors of $5.00, $5.00, $5.00 and $10.00. Dormancy stands at 12 months on the two lowest plans, 18 months on the next two and 24 months on the top two, and the only plan carrying a dormancy charge is the Prepaid Declining Balance Account at $2.00 a month, every other plan printing $0.00.
